ledger.x: 20 November 1945: the Azerbaijan Democratic Party seizes Tabriz and the province.
11-12 December 1946: the Iranian army retakes Tabriz.

wars.name: Iran crisis of 1946
wars.outcome: Iranian victory: Soviet troops left on 6 May 1946 and Iranian forces entered Tabriz on 11 December and Mahabad on 15 December 1946, dissolving both republics.

certainty.note: Rebel-held ground under Soviet cover: no page gives a boundary, and the Mahabad Republic claimed Urmia, Khoy and Salmas.
